source_policy: Align own evidence branch with corrected candidate before measurement-only changes. Never push integration or master. Optional instrumentation off by default. No production optimisation in this investigation.

H1.claim: GPU starvation from CPU or relay accounts for the gap
H1.falsifier: Same-workload GPU busy% equal within5 percentage points for kayfabe and VFIO while performance still differs
H1.limit: No paired conclusion without a comparable GPU busy series; old scores alone are insufficient

H2.falsifier: Low KVM exit rate and measured exit-service time during active workload windows
H2.method: Separate profiling arm; per-thread CPU, perf kvm tracepoints and GPU telemetry, never headline score timing

H3.claim: USER guest-doorbell to native submission queueing dominates
H3.falsifier: Direct paired-submit p99 below100us with no growth under load, adequate sample coverage and coalescing accounted for
H3.method: GPU-free tested atomic bounded aggregator; measure next native doorbell completion on same ring; report unmatched/fanout/failed calls separately; no GSP proxy relabelling

H4.claim: Display/present caps rather than rendering account for the gap
H4.falsifier: A verified no-present workload preserves the same performance ratio
H4.limit: Headless test broker still permits guest presents and is not a no-present workload

arms.scope: separate CATIA/Creo profiling, one iteration each, existing K2 carrier and9216MiB; GPU/CPU/KVM telemetry
measurement-build native gates then separate CATIA/Creo direct-submit profiling
VFIO only after inspecting VF1 restoration procedure and establishing safe recovery; otherwise recorded evidence and explicit unmatched limitation

safety: one VM, bounded fastguest lease, own quiet flag, baseline Xid delta fatal on any new Xid; stop at first host problem, restore NVIDIA/cuInit0/GDM/ubuntu/monitors; no rm -f or rm -rf
publication: SPEC values exclusively stamped(nc) with release/configuration/disclaimer; Steel/Geekbench numbers private
result: Perf investigation cannot change prior PARTIAL/HOLD correctness verdict
